ogDesc: The best hotels in Kamala by budget.
intro: Kamala is the pick for travellers who want a calm Phuket beach rather than Patong's all-night party. By day the beach is quiet and suits families and couples who want to lie around, swim, and eat by the sea without a crowd. The village has Thai restaurants and seafood spots at local prices, while the hillside at the north end of the beach (the so-called Millionaire's Mile) holds several luxury sea-view resorts. Patong is about a 15-minute drive away if you want nightlife. One thing to know: Kamala has no real public transport, so getting around mostly means a rental car, taxis, or hotel shuttles.

blocks.html: Short answer: Kamala is a quiet beach between Patong and Surin, with a far more family-friendly, laid-back feel than Patong. It has a long sandy beach, clear water, a small local village with Thai eateries, and a hillside stretch known as Millionaire's Mile lined with upscale resorts. Stays range from cheap guesthouses for a few hundred baht to 5-star beachfront resorts running several thousand a night.

items.name: KC Kamala Guesthouse
items.meta: ★ 2-star · Best for: Budget · close to the beach · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A small, cheap guesthouse in Kamala village, about a 6-minute walk to the beach. Rooms have air-con, a TV, and a balcony. Reviews sit around 8.6, praising the friendly staff and a location within walking distance of restaurants and the sand. Good for solo travellers or couples who want to keep costs down and just need a clean bed near the sea.

items.name: Sabina Guesthouse Kamala
items.meta: ★ 2-star · Best for: Budget · breakfast included · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A tiny guesthouse with a handful of rooms, about a 5-minute walk from Kamala Beach. Reviews like the breakfast and the caring owners, with an overall score around 8.6. To be straight, the rooms are very simple, and some street-facing ones pick up motorbike noise, so ask for an interior room if you can. A fit for budget travellers who aren't fussy about polish.

items.name: Novotel Phuket Kamala Beach
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Families · right on the beach · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A 4-star resort sitting right on Kamala Beach, which is rare in this area. It has a pool, family rooms, and kids' activities, with the sand just across from it. Reviews praise the beachfront spot and the breakfast. A good choice for families who want to wake up to the sea and let the kids swim all day without travelling.

items.name: Cape Sienna Phuket Gourmet Hotel & Villas
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Sea views for the price · couples · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A resort on the headland at the end of Kamala Beach, with most rooms facing the sea and clear views over Kamala Bay. It has an infinity pool and several restaurants, and sits about 400m from the beach, reachable on foot or by hotel shuttle. A fit for couples who want a 5-star sea view at a still-reachable price. The trade-off is the up-and-down hillside walk.

items.name: Kamala Beach Resort, A Sunprime Resort - Adults Only
items.meta: ★ 4-star · Best for: Adults only · beachfront · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: An adults-only beachfront resort (guests 16 and over). The standout is four pools, two of them right by the beach, and a calm feel without children around. The sand is steps away and Kamala village is close. A fit for couples or groups of friends who want quiet and a seafront spot without a long walk.

items.name: Twinpalms MontAzure Phuket
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Spacious suites · special occasions · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: A luxury beachfront resort on Kamala Beach and a member of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, with only about 46 suites and penthouses. Every unit is spacious with a living area and a terrace over the pool or sea, and there's an affiliated beach club within walking distance. A fit for couples or anyone wanting a large room and high-end service for a special occasion.

items.name: InterContinental Phuket Resort by IHG
items.meta: ★ 5-star · Best for: Beachfront · full-scale luxury · 🔎 Find a deal on Agoda
items.blurb: The flagship 5-star beachfront resort of the area, set into green hills with Andaman Sea views. It has multiple pools, several restaurants (including ones in the MICHELIN Guide), a spa, and private pool villas. Reviews score it around 9. A fit for travellers who want a large, full-service resort right on the beach for a celebration or honeymoon.

faq.q: Is Kamala good for families or couples?
faq.a: It works well for both. The beach is quieter and safer-feeling than Patong, the water is fairly clear, and there are beachfront family resorts like Novotel as well as adults-only options like Sunprime. Couples after a sea view have several hillside resorts to choose from. Travellers who want all-night nightlife may find Kamala too quiet.

faq.q: Is it easy to get around Kamala and over to Patong?
faq.a: Kamala has no real public transport, so getting around mostly means a rental car, taxis, a ride-hailing app, or hotel shuttles. Patong is about a 15-minute drive over a coastal hill road. If you plan to go out often, renting a scooter or car is far more convenient and better value.

It's the nickname for the hillside stretch at the north end of Kamala Beach, lined with luxury villas and sea-view resorts. The spot gives wide views over the Andaman Sea, and resorts like Cape Sienna and Twinpalms MontAzure sit in this zone. For the best sea views, look at the hillside properties, but expect to go up and down the hill or use a shuttle to reach the sand.
